definition_en: of the darkest colour, like coal or the night sky
scene: 深夜的巷子没有一盏灯。He wore a black coat in the dark.
sceneCN: 这里 black 是「黑色的」（第 1 个义项：颜色最深的）；句意是黑暗中他穿着一件黑色外套。

senses.title: Of the darkest colour
senses.definition: having the darkest colour, like coal
senses.definitionCN: 颜色最深的，像煤一样
senses.example: He wore a black coat in the dark.
senses.exampleCN: 黑暗中他穿着一件黑色外套。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, naming the darkest end of colour.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指颜色最深的那一端。

senses.title: With no light
senses.definition: completely dark because there is no light
senses.definitionCN: 因为完全没有光而一片漆黑
senses.example: The room was black until the lamp came on.
senses.exampleCN: 灯亮之前房间里一片漆黑。
senses.why: A place without light looks the same colour as black ink.
senses.whyCN: 没有光的地方，看起来和黑墨水是同一种颜色。

senses.title: Served without milk
senses.definition: coffee served without milk or cream
senses.definitionCN: 不加牛奶或奶油的咖啡
senses.example: She drinks her coffee black.
senses.exampleCN: 她喝咖啡不加奶。
senses.why: Dark coffee was described by its colour, and the habit kept the word.
senses.whyCN: 深色的咖啡用颜色来描述，这个说法沿用了下来。

intro.en: Black is an Old English colour word that also took over senses of darkness.

definition_en: the flat cutting part of a knife or tool
scene: 厨房的灯照着案板上的刀。The blade caught the light as she cut.
sceneCN: 这里 blade 是「刀刃」（第 1 个义项：刀具扁平的锋利部分）；句意是她切菜时刀刃反了一下光。

derivatives.zh: 语义关联词，义为「叶丛」，与 blade 的叶片义相关

senses.title: The cutting part of a tool
senses.definition: the flat sharp part of a knife or tool
senses.definitionCN: 刀或其他工具上扁平锋利的部分
senses.example: The blade caught the light as she cut.
senses.exampleCN: 她切菜时刀刃反了一下光。
senses.why: The shape of a leaf was lent to the flat edge of a cutting tool.
senses.whyCN: 叶片的形状被借用来指刀具扁平的刃口。

senses.title: A long thin leaf
senses.definition: a long narrow leaf, especially of grass
senses.definitionCN: 细长的叶子，尤指草叶
senses.example: A single blade of grass bent in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 一片草叶在风里弯下腰。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, still used for grass and leaves.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，至今仍用于草叶与叶片。

senses.title: A flat part that pushes air or water
senses.definition: a flat part of a propeller or fan
senses.definitionCN: 螺旋桨或风扇上推动空气或水的扁平部件
senses.example: One fan blade was bent out of shape.
senses.exampleCN: 有一片扇叶变形了。
senses.why: The leaf shape returned in machines that move air or water.
senses.whyCN: 在推动空气或水的机器里，叶片的形状又回来了。

intro.en: Blade first meant a leaf, and the cutting sense came from that shape.

items.en: blade covers tools, grass and rotors.
items.cn: 如今 blade 兼指刀具、草叶与转轮叶片。

definition_en: to say that someone is responsible for something bad
core_image: 争执中指向对方的手指
scene: 会议室里两个人争得面红耳赤。Do not blame the driver for the delay.
sceneCN: 这里 blame 是「责怪」（第 1 个义项：认为某人应对坏事负责）；句意是别把延误怪到司机头上。

derivatives.zh: 无可指责的，没有过错的
应受责备的，该担责任的

senses.title: To say someone caused harm
senses.definition: to say that a person is responsible for something bad
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人对坏结果负有责任
senses.example: Do not blame the driver for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 别把延误怪到司机头上。
senses.why: This is the central sense, aimed at a person.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义项，对象是人。

senses.title: To put a bad result down to something
senses.definition: to say that a thing or condition caused a problem
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事物或某种情况造成了问题
senses.example: Experts blame the heat for the crop failure.
senses.exampleCN: 专家把歉收归咎于高温。
senses.why: The same accusation can be aimed at a cause rather than a person.
senses.whyCN: 同样的指责也可以指向原因，而不是人。

senses.title: Responsibility for a fault
senses.definition: the responsibility for something that went wrong
senses.definitionCN: 对出错之事所负的责任
senses.example: She took the blame for the mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 她为这个错误承担了责任。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the fault itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为名词，指过错本身。

items.en: blame entered English as both verb and noun.

items.en: blame moved from harsh speech to the fault itself.

senses.title: With nothing written
senses.definition: having no writing, print or marks

senses.example: She stared at the blank page for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 她对着空白的一页看了一个小时。
senses.why: White paper looked empty, so the colour word became the word for empty.

definition_en: a thick cover used to keep warm in bed
core_image: 沙发上叠得厚厚的毛毯
scene: 沙发上叠着一条厚厚的毛毯。She pulled the blanket up to her chin.
sceneCN: 这里 blanket 是「毯子」（第 1 个义项：保暖的厚覆盖物）；句意是她把毯子拉到下巴。

senses.title: A thick warm bed cover
senses.definition: a thick cover made of wool or similar material for warmth
senses.definitionCN: 用羊毛或类似材料制成、用于保暖的厚覆盖物
senses.example: She pulled the blanket up to her chin.
senses.exampleCN: 她把毯子拉到下巴。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a cloth spread over a sleeper.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，一块盖在睡觉者身上的布。

senses.title: A thick covering layer
senses.definition: a thick layer that covers something completely
senses.definitionCN: 把某物完全盖住的厚厚一层
senses.example: A blanket of snow covered the field.
senses.exampleCN: 一层积雪盖住了田野。
senses.why: Snow spread like cloth over the ground, so the cover word extended.
senses.whyCN: 积雪像布一样铺在地上，覆盖物这个词就扩展开来。

senses.title: Applying to everything
senses.definition: affecting all cases or people without exception
senses.definitionCN: 无一例外地影响所有情况或所有人
senses.example: The city issued a blanket ban on smoking.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市发布了全面禁烟令。
senses.why: A cover over everything became an image for a rule over everything.
senses.whyCN: 盖住一切的布，成了覆盖一切的规定这一意象。

definition_en: an explosion, or a sudden strong movement of air
scene: 远处山脚腾起一团灰白的烟尘。The blast shook the windows of the town.

senses.title: A sudden explosion
senses.definition: a sudden violent burst of energy
senses.definitionCN: 突然而猛烈的能量爆开
senses.example: The blast shook the windows of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 爆炸震动了镇上的窗户。
senses.why: Gunpowder work gave the word this violent sense.
senses.whyCN: 炸药的作业让这个词有了这层猛烈的意思。

senses.title: A sudden rush of air
senses.definition: a sudden strong movement of air
senses.definitionCN: 突然而强劲的一股气流
senses.example: A blast of cold air hit us at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 一开门，一股冷风扑面而来。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from the idea of blowing.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自「吹」这个概念。

senses.title: A very loud sudden noise
senses.definition: a sudden loud sound, as from a horn or trumpet
senses.definitionCN: 号角或喇叭发出的突然巨响
senses.example: The blast of the horn made her jump.
senses.exampleCN: 喇叭的巨响吓了她一跳。
senses.why: A horn blast is a burst of air made audible.
senses.whyCN: 号角声就是把一股气流变成了能听见的爆响。

senses.title: A strong attack in words
senses.definition: a very strong criticism
senses.definitionCN: 非常严厉的批评
senses.example: The film drew a blast from critics.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影招来评论家的猛烈批评。
senses.why: Verbal attack borrowed the force of an explosion.
senses.whyCN: 言语攻击借用了爆炸的力量感。

definition_en: to lose blood from the body
core_image: 手指被纸划破后渗出的血珠
scene: 纸边划破了她的手指，血珠慢慢鼓起来。His hand bled for a minute or two.
sceneCN: 这里 bleed 是「流血」（第 1 个义项：血液从身体流出）；句意是他的手流了一两分钟的血。

pos.zh: 动词：榨取钱财，使人耗尽资源

derivatives.zh: 易出血的人，口语中也指血友病患者

senses.title: To lose blood
senses.definition: to lose blood from a wound or the body
senses.definitionCN: 因伤口或身体原因失去血液
senses.example: His hand bled for a minute or two.
senses.exampleCN: 他的手流了一两分钟的血。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, tied directly to blood.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，与 blood 直接相连。

senses.title: To let liquid escape
senses.definition: to let a liquid flow out slowly
senses.definitionCN: 让液体慢慢流出
senses.example: The old pipe was bleeding water onto the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 旧管子把水漏到了地板上。
senses.why: A leaking pipe looked like a wound that would not close.
senses.whyCN: 漏水的管子像一道合不上的伤口。

senses.title: To drain someone of money
senses.definition: to take too much money or strength from someone
senses.definitionCN: 从某人身上拿走过多钱财或精力
senses.example: The scheme bled the company dry.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划把公司的钱榨干了。
senses.why: Losing money was pictured as losing blood.
senses.whyCN: 失去钱财被比作失血。

definition_en: to mix two or more things together smoothly
core_image: 搅拌机里旋成漩涡的果泥
scene: 搅拌机转起来，果块渐渐化成漩涡。Blend the fruit with a little milk.
sceneCN: 这里 blend 是「混合」（第 1 个义项：把几种东西搅在一起）；句意是把水果加一点牛奶搅匀。

derivatives.zh: 搅拌机，把食物打碎混合的电器
混合，把不同成分调和在一起的过程

senses.title: To mix smoothly together
senses.definition: to mix two or more things until they are combined
senses.definitionCN: 把两种或更多东西搅到合为一体
senses.example: Blend the fruit with a little milk.
senses.exampleCN: 把水果加一点牛奶搅匀。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from an old verb meaning to mix.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自一个意为混合的古动词。

senses.title: To fit in with surroundings
senses.definition: to look or sound natural together
senses.definitionCN: 放在一起看起来或听起来自然
senses.example: The new houses blend with the old street.
senses.exampleCN: 新房子与老街很协调。
senses.why: Things that mix well also look as if they belong together.
senses.whyCN: 混得好的东西，看起来也像是本来就在一起。

senses.title: A mixture of things
senses.definition: a combination of different things
senses.definitionCN: 不同东西组合成的整体
senses.example: This tea is a blend of three leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 这款茶由三种茶叶拼配而成。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the result of mixing.
senses.whyCN: 动词转为名词，指混合的结果。

senses.title: To ask for divine protection
senses.definition: to ask God to protect and help a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 祈求神明保护并帮助某人或某物
senses.example: The priest blessed the couple at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师在门口为这对夫妇祝福。
senses.why: This is the central religious sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词核心的宗教义项。

senses.title: To give someone a good thing

senses.example: She is blessed with a fine voice.

senses.why: A gift from God became any fortunate gift.

senses.definitionCN: 拥有某样足以自豪的东西
senses.example: The town boasts two fine museums.
senses.exampleCN: 这座镇上有两座很好的博物馆。
senses.why: Places and things were said to boast of what they had.
senses.whyCN: 地方与事物也被说成在夸耀自己所拥有的东西。

intro.en: Boast began as a word for noisy display and settled on self-praise.
intro.cn: boast 本指喧闹的展示，后来固定在自夸这一意思上。

items.en: bost meant a noisy display.
items.cn: bost 意为喧闹的展示。

items.en: boast named loud self-praise.
items.cn: boast 指大声的自夸。

items.en: boast also meant to possess proudly.
items.cn: boast 也开始表示自豪地拥有。

items.en: boastful and boaster joined the family.
items.cn: boastful 与 boaster 加入这个词族。

items.en: boast covers bragging and proud possession.
items.cn: 如今 boast 兼指吹牛与自豪地拥有。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -oast ending; the near-meaning group names pride and bragging.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -oast 的词形；近义组是自豪与吹牛类词。

entries.definition: a long thin piece of wood
to walk in a proud way

normalIntro.en: To boast is to turn your own praise up too loud.
normalIntro.cn: boast 就是把自己的夸奖声调调得太高。

normal.en: Boast about and boast of both take a thing.
normal.cn: boast about 与 boast of 后面都接对象。

normal.en: A hotel can boast a fine view.
normal.cn: 酒店可以「拥有」好景致。

normal.en: Boastful is the adjective.
normal.cn: 形容词是 boastful。

normal.en: A boaster talks about himself.
normal.cn: boaster 是爱谈自己的人。

normal.en: Boast and roast differ by one letter.
normal.cn: boast 与 roast 只差一个字母。

abstract.en: See someone pointing at his own car.
abstract.cn: 想象有人指着自己的车。

abstract.en: See a chest puffed out in pride.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人自豪地挺起胸膛。

abstract.en: See a town sign listing its museums.
abstract.cn: 想象镇口的牌子列出博物馆。

examples.en: He likes to boast about his new car.
examples.cn: 他喜欢炫耀自己的新车。

examples.en: The town boasts two fine museums.
examples.cn: 这座镇上有两座很好的博物馆。

examples.en: Without boasting, I did most of the work.
examples.cn: 不是自夸，大部分活是我干的。

dict_mnemonic.text: boast 与 roast（烤）只差一个字母，自夸过头，就像被火烤着一样难受。

root: boast 源自盎格鲁诺曼语 bost（喧闹的展示），中古英语指大声自夸，十六世纪起又表示自豪地拥有某物，并衍生出 boastful 与 boaster。

sensesIntro.en: Loud praise of oneself, and the pride of owning something good.
sensesIntro.cn: 大声夸奖自己，以及拥有好东西时的自豪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a man tapping his chest while talking.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人边说边拍胸口。

branches.cn: 这座镇拥有一座博物馆

intro.en: Boast adds -ful and -er to make an adjective and a person noun.
intro.cn: boast 加 -ful 与 -er 构成形容词和人物名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is French; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自法语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_en: a small vehicle that travels on water
core_image: 停在木栈桥边的小木船
scene: 木栈桥边系着一条浅色小船。They rowed the boat across the quiet lake.
sceneCN: 这里 boat 是「小船」（第 1 个义项：在水上行驶的小型交通工具）；句意是他们划船穿过安静的湖面。

senses.title: A small craft for water
senses.definition: a small vehicle that travels on water
senses.definitionCN: 在水上行进的小型交通工具
senses.example: They rowed the boat across the quiet lake.
senses.exampleCN: 他们划船穿过安静的湖面。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a small wooden vessel.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指一只小木船。

senses.title: A ship of any size
senses.definition: any vessel that carries people on water
senses.definitionCN: 任何在水上载人的船只
senses.example: They crossed the ocean by boat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们乘船横渡大洋。
senses.why: The small word widened to cover passenger ships.
senses.whyCN: 这个小词后来扩展到载客的大船。

senses.title: To travel in a boat for pleasure
senses.definition: to travel on water in a small craft for fun
senses.definitionCN: 为消遣而乘小船在水上游玩
senses.example: We boated along the river all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们整个下午都在河上划船。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the activity.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，指这项活动。

intro.en: Boat is an old Germanic word for a small wooden craft.
intro.cn: boat 是一个古老的日耳曼语词，指小木船。

items.en: bat named a small wooden vessel.
items.cn: bat 指一只小木船。

items.en: boat kept the general sense of a small craft.
items.cn: boat 保留了小型船只的通称义。

items.en: boat could mean any vessel on water.
items.cn: boat 可指水上任何船只。

items.en: boating became a weekend pastime.
items.cn: 划船成为周末消遣。

items.en: boat covers small craft and leisure on water.
items.cn: 如今 boat 兼指小船与水上休闲。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -oat shape; the near-meaning group names larger craft.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -oat 的词形；近义组是更大的船只类词。

entries.definition: a shoe that covers the ankle
a large vessel for the sea
a craft that travels on water
a narrow light boat moved by paddles

normalIntro.en: A boat is a small wooden shape floating on water.
normalIntro.cn: boat 是一只漂在水上的小木船。

normal.en: By boat means travelling on water.
normal.cn: by boat 表示乘船。

normal.en: Row a boat uses oars, not an engine.
normal.cn: row a boat 用桨，不用发动机。

normal.en: A fishing boat is a working boat.
normal.cn: fishing boat 是作业用的渔船。

normal.en: Boating is the leisure activity.
normal.cn: boating 指划船这项休闲活动。

normal.en: Boat and boot differ by one letter.
normal.cn: boat 与 boot 只差一个字母。

abstract.en: See a small boat tied to a wooden pier.
abstract.cn: 想象一条小船系在木栈桥边。

abstract.en: See oars leaving rings on still water.
abstract.cn: 想象船桨在静水上留下圆圈。

abstract.en: See a ferry leaving the harbour.
abstract.cn: 想象渡轮驶离港口。

examples.en: They rowed the boat across the quiet lake.
examples.cn: 他们划船穿过安静的湖面。

examples.en: They crossed the ocean by boat.
examples.cn: 他们乘船横渡大洋。

examples.en: We boated along the river all afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们整个下午都在河上划船。

dict_mnemonic.text: boat 与 boot（靴子）只差一个字母，船就像一只漂在水上的大靴子。

root: boat 源自古英语 bat，属日耳曼语同源词，本指小木船；中古英语保留通称义，十五世纪起可指任何船只，十九世纪又衍生出划船休闲的动词用法。

sensesIntro.en: A small craft, any vessel, and the pleasure of rowing.
sensesIntro.cn: 一只小船、任何船只，以及划船的乐趣。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small wooden boat tied to a pier.
core.cn: 核心意象：系在木栈桥边的小木船。

intro.en: Boat adds -ing for the activity and -er for the person.
intro.cn: boat 加 -ing 指活动，加 -er 指人。

latinIntro.cn: 词基来自古英语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。
